metadata.postgres: PostgreSQL 14.13 (Homebrew) on aarch64-apple-darwin24.1.0, compiled by Apple clang version 16.0.0 (clang-1600.0.26.4), 64-bit
metadata.scope: Warm-cache bursts sharing one flat graph instance and pool, Unix socket. Request latency includes waiting for graph query slots. Wave CPU is averaged per request and excludes PostgreSQL CPU. Final JSON serialization is outside the measurement.
